item.title: Show HN: Doomscroll GitHub Instead of TikTok
item.summary: GitHub is full of awesome projects and I love discovering things other people have built, but GitHub's UX for discovering projects is honestly just not good. So I built it myself: https://roamers.dev It's an endless feed of GitHub projects, free for you to roam around and discover. You can either sign in with GitHub and tune it to your interests, or just browse anonymously. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49165838 Points: 1 # Comments: 2
